---
# generated by scripts/sync-agents.mjs from .agents/.commands/enhance.md — edit that file, then run `make agents_sync`.
description: Enhance one named element of the web UI inside the existing design system via the impeccable skill, leaving everything around it untouched
argument-hint: <target and optional direction, e.g. "nav.skills-rail" | "/skills panel bolder" | "sync-panel bolder">
---

## User Input

```text
$ARGUMENTS
```

1. Treat the User Input as `<target> [direction]`. A URL in it names the route (its path, no host); a DOM path (`#root > … > div.skills-rail`) names the element inside that route's page, by its last class. Backend-only or non-UI input → say so and STOP. Empty → ask which element and what feels lacking.
2. Resolve the target to source files, first match wins, and state the files in one line so the user can correct them:
   - a file path;
   - a CSS selector or class (`nav.skills-rail`, `.repo-head`) → grep `apps/web/src` for the class, take the component that renders it plus its rules in `index.css`;
   - a route (`/skills`) → the page component that route renders, then the single element the user named;
   - a component or sheet name → its file in `apps/web/src`.
   Nothing resolves → list the nearest candidates and ask.
3. Fix the scope: the named element, its own CSS block, and its tests. Everything outside it stays unchanged: neighbors, the page, the tokens.
4. Read `.agents/skills/agentic-os/impeccable/SKILL.md` in full and follow its `Local Overrides`; run its context step with `--target <file>`. `PRODUCT.md` Brand Commitments and `DESIGN.md` are binding: no new hue, token, shadow, or system primitive. A spec in `.physarum/docs/specs/` that names this element and has `## Design` is the brief; a change that departs from it goes through `/backsync` first. Route a direction word (`bolder`, `layout`, `clarify`, `adapt`…) to its `reference/<name>.md`; no direction word → `reference/bolder.md`. A reference missing from the vendored folder → say so in one line and continue from `SKILL.md` plus the references that exist; do not reconstruct it from memory.
5. Look before editing. The app must answer on `http://localhost:3000` (start `make dev` when it does not; on macOS free a busy `:3000` by hand first). Screenshot the element at 1440px and 390px wide in every state it can reach (empty, loading, error, long content), then name the shipped pattern in `DESIGN.md` or `index.css` that the result will mirror. Record `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status --short` before editing: files already modified are not yours, and "the base commit" below is that HEAD.
6. Pin behavior. Grep `apps/web/tests` for the element's names and list the roles, accessible names, and text the tests assert; the enhancement leaves them intact.
7. Name in one line the single move that raises the element and what recedes around it, so the move stays legible. A move that needs a change outside the element → STOP and tell the user the structure must change beyond one element, and suggest asking for a redesign of the target.
8. Behavior is not part of an enhancement by default. When the move needs new behavior inside the element (a filter, a shortcut, a new control), list it and ask once before building; the answer decides whether it ships.
9. Build in one pass, then verify once, batched:
   - `impeccable detect --json <changed files>` must return no findings;
   - `cd apps/web && npm run build`, the element's vitest file, then the full web suite once (Node 22 if the default Node fails on `undici`);
   - one visual round at 1440px and 390px over every state named in the look step, all fixes in one batch, at most one confirming round;
   - `git diff -U0 -- <changed files>` shows hunks only in the element's component, its CSS block, and its tests, and `git status --short` adds no file beyond them.
   Report failures as they are; a failure that also occurs without your diff is pre-existing, so run the same test at the base commit before saying so.
10. Keep the tree clean. Save screenshots with viewport shots under `.playwright-mcp/` (an element-targeted shot clicks the page). `.playwright-mcp/` holds tracked files: delete only files you created, never the folder. Revert `apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` when the build dirtied it.
11. STOP with a short report: the move, what was left untouched, behavior added (if any), build and test result, and what was not visually checked. Suggest `/impeccable critique <target>` for an independent review.
